evaluation_role: common retrospective baseline comparison; outcomes previously exposed
reference_choice: strong full_model SFT checkpoint fixed as primary reference before panel_tools.1 policy experiments

recent_train_popularity.population: all known catalog events in global_split=train; organic and non-organic both included

evaluation.aggregation: event macro within user, then user macro; one fixed event per user
evaluation.mapping_checks: unique raw item IDs; unique contiguous token IDs 3..N+2; checkpoint vocab equals catalog plus PAD/BOS/OOV

controls.selection: fixed at 1.0 before panel_tools policy comparisons; no panel_tools alpha sweep

limitations: The source validation outcomes and all V1-full_model periods are previously explored; this is retrospective reanalysis.
The full_model actors may have user/event overlap with A_RL; checkpoint availability does not create an actor holdout.
Popularity, Markov, history frequency, and actor rankings are recommendation baselines, not causal policy estimates.

markov.selection: fixed at 1.0 before panel_tools policy comparisons; no panel_tools alpha sweep

full_core_metrics.aggregation: event metrics averaged within user, then user-macro; one frozen event per user
full_core_metrics.tie_break: score descending, raw item ID ascending; reranker uses base actor order only to break equal history counts
full_core_metrics.oov_targets: unconditional misses retained in the denominator

weak_actor_metrics.aggregation: mean events within user, then mean across users
weak_actor_metrics.target_selection: pre-frozen event IDs; OOV targets retained as misses
